text:
maria (PM): Ok kicking off a short decision thread for the observability slice we promised customers: dashboards (per-route cost/latency/error), basic tracing hooks, and first-pass error analytics. Want to land a low-risk launch.
ajay (SRE): +1. Need to be explicit about what we consider MVP vs. stretch. Customers asked for per-route cost by default which is non-negotiable for commerce teams.
leah (infra): Reality check: we can deliver a per-route cost card showing total tokens, estimated $ spend, avg latency, and error rate. Breaking cost down by model variant/quantization will need extra join work.
kevin (eng): For tracing hooks: do we plan to record every span for errors only, or also collect a small tail sample for latency debugging? Sampling and storage have big infra impacts.
maria (PM): My proposal: MVP tracing = capture error spans at 100% (for insight on failures) + a tiny tail sample (1%) for latency investigations. Full trace UX (flamegraphs, waterfall view) is phase 2.
olivia (data): For the cost reports we need a stable join between billing events and telemetry rows. That join is non-trivial; ETA is ~3 sprints unless we accept hourly buckets instead of per-request accuracy.
ajay (SRE): Gating concerns: error-span capture at 100% increases CPU + disk. We should gate by plan and default to off for self-serve orgs until we size it.
kevin (eng): Implementation plan: feature-flag per-org for trace capture. Default: off for self-serve, on for enterprise with opt-in. Rollout cadence: 3% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% across orgs.
maria (PM): Draft launch checklist:
- Dashboard: per-route cost estimate, avg latency, error rate
- Trace hooks: error-span capture behind flag
- Sampling: 1% tail latency sample globally (optional cut)
- Rollout: canary with org-level feature flags
- Docs: quickstart + cost implications and retention notes
- QA: synthetic traffic, burst tests, and backfill validation
- SLOs: telemetry ingest 99.9% availability
leah (infra): Add infra acceptance: default retention, indexing throughput test, and a clear backfill approach for first 90 days of data.
olivia (data): Error analytics needs a minimal taxonomy to be useful. Suggest MVP taxonomy: HTTP 4xx/5xx, Model-rejection, Timeout. We can expand later.
maria (PM): Agreed. Keep taxonomy narrow for MVP.
kevin (eng): Note: attaching tracing metadata to existing requests can increase KV cache churn. Mitigation: batch trace writes and async flush to reduce IO spikes.
ajay (SRE): Monitoring TODOs: alert on trace ingestion > expected by 30% and per-org cost delta >20% over 24h window.
maria (PM): Customers also wanted a quick monthly forecast per-route. We can ship a lightweight forecast using last 7 days median QPS * avg token cost with a disclaimer about burstiness.
olivia (data): UI caveat: forecasts are estimates based on median QPS and median token cost; show confidence interval and call out burst risk.
kevin (eng): Rough dev sizing:
- Instrumentation hooks: 2w
- Ingestion joiner: 3w
- Dashboard frontend/widgets: 2w
- Rollout + flags + infra tests: 1.5w
- Docs + QA: 1w
maria (PM): If we need to trim scope, drop the 1% tail sample and launch with error-only traces + customer opt-in for tail sampling. Cost charts and error metrics remain required.
leah (infra): Alternate cut: ship dashboards (cost + error rate) first, delay trace UI until we scale sampling backend. This reduces initial infra risk.
ajay (SRE): My recommendation: enterprise opt-in only for 6 weeks, monitor ingest/cost, then open to self-serve with rate limits.
maria (PM): Decision proposal: follow Leah's lower-risk cut. Ship dashboards + error metrics broadly; trace hooks (error-only) enabled for enterprise opt-in. Phase 2 to add tail sampling and self-serve.
kevin (eng): +1 from eng. Keeps momentum and reduces blast radius.
olivia (data): +1
ajay (SRE): +1
maria (PM): Great. I'll update the roadmap and PRD with the reduced launch surface and the acceptance checklist. Need an owner for rollout plan and customer comms. @leah (infra) can you take it?
leah (infra): I can own rollout runbook and the CS comms draft. Will include opt-in flow, telemetry limits, and rollback plan.
maria (PM): Thanks. I'll attach the updated checklist to the PRD and share the updated timeline. Ping me if anyone wants to reopen scope before EOD.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging for feature-flag tests at 2026-03-24T02:00Z
maria (PM): noted :eyes:
